newsitem.title: USA: Maine weighs fee increases for Wildlife Dept.
newsitem.headline: Maine weighs fee increases for Wildlife Dept.

text.p: The Maine Legislature's Fish and Wildlife Committee unanimously recommended a package of new licenses and fees aimed at solving the state's Fish and Wildlife Department $800,000 deficit.
Senator Marge Kilkelly, D-Lincoln County, says most of the new revenue will come from a second season of deer hunting in September.
Another money-maker will be the moose hunting lottery, which has been expanded to give hunters more opportunities to win a permit.
And there are proposals to increase the cost of motor boat and jet ski registrations to as much as $20 a year.
The department has also been ordered to find nearly $250,000 of personnel cuts.
